# WebGPU implementation peers

<!-- Generated by bench.tools.render_implementation_peers; do not edit. -->

The canonical inventory is [implementation-peers.json](../config/implementation-peers.json), validated by its
[schema](../config/implementation-peers.schema.json).
Implementation families, compiler identities, native provider IDs and
tracking links are edited there. Registry order preserves provider order.

Provider membership describes identity, not runnable support, conformance,
or a performance ranking. [Compare profiles](benchmark-taxonomy.md) govern
available execution; retained artifacts own exact revisions, library
hashes, measurements and claim scope. Empty evidence links mean no evidence
is indexed here, not proof that no historical experiment exists.
[Ecosystem actor scores](ecosystem.md) remain a separate authority for
adoption and relationships; package bindings are not new engine families.

Regenerate with `python3 -m bench.tools.render_implementation_peers`.
Use `--check` to detect drift; the blocking schema gate also checks this view.

## Dawn

C++ native implementation used by Chromium; package bindings are separate integration surfaces.

Upstream research, native and package comparisons are tracked. Exact source and library identities belong to each retained run, not this inventory.

## WebKit

Safari WebGPU implementation backed by Metal; Doe also has a standalone WebKit bootstrap and delegate lane definitions.

Bootstrap and lane declarations are tracked. They do not establish a fresh matched comparison or qualified provider substitution.

Tracking:

- [bench/tools/bootstrap_webkit_webgpu.py](../bench/tools/bootstrap_webkit_webgpu.py)
- [config/backend-runtime-policy.json](../config/backend-runtime-policy.json)
- [config/backend-lane-map.json](../config/backend-lane-map.json)

## wgpu

Rust implementation used by Firefox, Servo and Deno. wgpu-native provides C bindings over wgpu-core; it is not an independent implementation family. Browser-targeted wgpu can use the browser provider.

Native provider identity is declared. This inventory does not add an executor, a promoted comparison profile, or measured evidence.

Tracking:

- [config/benchmark-cube-policy.json](../config/benchmark-cube-policy.json)

Evidence pointers:

No evidence indexed in this registry.

Upstream sources:

- [https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu](https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu)
- [https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu-native](https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu-native)
